from sys_user u left join sys_dept d on u.dept_id = d.dept_id left join sys_user_role ur on u.user_id = ur.user_id left join sys_role r on r.role_id = ur.role_id where u.del_flag = '0' and (r.role_id != #{user.roleId} or r.role_id IS NULL) and u.user_id not in ( select u2.user_id from sys_user u2 inner join sys_user_role ur2 on u2.user_id = ur2.user_id and ur2.role_id = #{user.roleId} )
